synthesis.guidance: Use a dialog for a bounded task; if its tabs contain an entire application, move them to a page. The inspected playground separates open/onClose from Tab.Group and its list/panels. Carry that separation into the current installed API, replacing numbered tabs with task sections and sizing the dialog to real content. IMPORTANT: this playground uses compound Dialog.Panel and Tab.Group syntax and lacks an explicit dialog title; it is a historical composition reference, not a current drop-in or accessibility-complete example. Add the current library's accessible DialogTitle/heading and verify tab keyboard navigation, dismissal and focus return. Use existing surface and spacing tokens; Tailwind utilities are not a visual identity. The local Button helper and dependencies are neither archived nor installed.

synthesis.summary: A playground nests a tab list and panels inside a controlled dialog, separating overlay visibility from within-dialog navigation. Useful for focused multi-section tasks.
